concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-capital-account-structure-resources]] — 2026-01-02-modified Capital resource map for user/legal-entity/transfer-instrument roles, non-funds per-currency grant accounts and per-paid-grant references (captured 2026-09-15).
warnings: Grant account tracks Adyen receivables and holds no funds; do not treat it as user or liable cash balance.
Grant-reference Active/Repaid and signed sample balances describe resource state, not proof of a live user's disbursement, bank receipt, or debt discharge.
Transfer instrument is described here as the grant payout destination, while the Capital overview also mentions possible balance-account funding; do not make an exclusive universal destination claim.
